instruction: Configure Chrome to enforce a minimum font size of 18 pixels to ensure all text is readable for users with visual impairments.

metadata.explanation: Task requires setting minimum font size to at least 18px. The evaluator checks if minimum_font_size >= 18.

llm_judge_reasons: Complete coverage: Evaluator correctly verifies the instruction requirement (minimum font size >= 18 pixels)
Correct getter logic: Extracts webkit.webprefs.minimum_font_size from Chrome Preferences JSON across multiple OS platforms
Correct metric logic: Properly handles expected parameter from get_rule() and performs range check [18, 99999]
Appropriate postconfig: Restarts Chrome to ensure settings are persisted to disk before verification
Robust edge case handling: Returns default value of 0 when setting is missing or errors occur, causing proper verification failure
Correct data flow: Getter extracts numeric value, metric compares against semantically correct range, expected values match task requirements
